items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mrs. Heath used to invite everybody for dinner, everybody. Every group that came to town, she would fix dinner for them. ... She knew all the musicians.

ctx.x: How about Beryl Booker? That’s a somewhat obscure . . .

Beryl was a phemon lady piano player from Philadelphia. She was known around there a lot, and Dinah liked her. Occasionally we would need a piano player after Wynton quit. After Wynton quit, there was a variety of piano players. So we had Beryl. At that particular time we had Beryl. So that was what we used in the theater. She was a good player. It was Beryl, Keter, myself, and the Symphony Sid All Stars. I remember Tootie Heath used to come through – he was about 12, 14 years old – and check us out, hang out. In…
